open: No owner plan; DSB lists only 'Elevator' and 'Trapper' (no escalators) while OSM maps several escalators. Platform-to-level assignment (-1 vs -2) and real level names not confirmed.
Toilets, lockers, waiting room, parking not on the DSB page; OSM toilet w1571069920 owner/fee unconfirmed.
7-Eleven hours conflict between DSB (perron 05.30-24.00; street shops 24h with a contradicting prose note), 7-Eleven's list and OSM.
Shops around Nørreport (Føtex, McDonald's, Netto, Matas, bars) are street shops outside the station and were left out.
The platform register's first polygon point for Nørreport lies ~500 m east of the station point (check the register geometry).
No open-question list was supplied for Danish stations.
